sloka: ततो लोकत्रयं जित्वा स्थाप्य नागान्सुरान्वशे ।समुद्रममृतार्थं च मथिष्यामि रसालयम् ।। ७.२०.१९ ॥
transliteration: tato lokatrayaṁ jitvā sthāpya nāgānsurānvaśe ।samudramamṛtārthaṁ ca mathiṣyāmi rasālayam ।। 7.20.19 ॥

translations.english: Ravana addresses the sage, declaring his readiness to descend to Rasatala for conquest.
